limitations: Focused admin installer integration, not a full installation/ACME/real LDAP/media rehearsal.
macOS sandbox file ownership checks bypassed; root-only checks covered by runner unit tests.

Only API and proxy rebuilt from exact source; independent PostgreSQL/Redis/RabbitMQ/MinIO instances use existing local infrastructure images. MinIO command/user/read-only adjusted for local fixture (production uses SeaweedFS). API capped at compact profile 160MiB and GOMEMLIMIT96MiB.
Host public HTTPS mapped to 18443, admin to 18081, HTTP to 18080; test CA explicitly trusted.
